title: Nebius Group N.V. unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: For Q2 2026 total revenue was USD 582.3 million and Nebius AI cloud revenue was USD 574.9 million; cash was USD 8.0421 billion at June 30.
summary: The current SEC-filed quarterly statements confirm the Q2 growth and operating leverage, but also a USD 190.4 million continuing-operations net loss, USD 5.6574 billion of quarterly capital purchases, USD 8.5457 billion of current and non-current debt, material customer-advance cash flows, and rising share-based compensation.
